strings.personnel-food.170: What is the minimum number of portions for a contract?
strings.personnel-food.171: Usually from 50 portions upwards; for smaller organisations, a contract or combined portions are still possible depending on the delivery distance and the number of meals. After the site visit, our specialist provides the most accurate estimate.

strings.personnel-food.174: Is corporate catering part of wages?
strings.personnel-food.175: Under Iranian labour law, food provided to staff counts as a non-cash benefit and carries its own insurance and tax implications. The contract sets out how meals are calculated and documented, and we recommend consulting your own financial and insurance adviser before signing.

strings.personnel-food.177: According to your working shifts; the delivery plan is defined in the contract and can also be arranged for night shifts, holidays and peak production days. Temporary changes are applied with prior coordination and in the shortest possible time.
